components.name: Button
components.description: Default outlined button for top-bar and panel actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg>Search</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, #e4e7ee); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #0e121b); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--soft, #f6f7fb); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #6a42e0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one ink-filled action per view (New enquiry).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>New enquiry</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #0e121b); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--ink, #0e121b); color: #fff; font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1c2230; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #6a42e0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The enquiry and follow-up input with attach, switch and send.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 520px; min-height: 50px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #e9ecf2); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(106, 66, 224, 0.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.04); font: 15px/24px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: #8f75ec; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(106, 66, 224, 0.16), 0 8px 24px rgba(106, 66, 224, 0.06); } .ds-composer input { border: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #0e121b); font: inherit; caret-color: var(--violet, #6a42e0); } .ds-composer input::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder, #767680); } .ds-attach { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, #e4e7ee); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: var(--body, #4b4f5c); cursor: pointer; } .ds-attach:hover { background: var(--soft, #f6f7fb); } .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--body, #4b4f5c); font-size: 14px; } .ds-track { position: relative; width: 34px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--track, #e2e3e8); } .ds-track::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.25); } .ds-send { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--ink, #0e121b); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-send:hover { background: #1c2230; } .ds-send:focus-visible, .ds-attach:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #6a42e0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Left icon rail; active item is violet on a soft pill with a 3px violet edge bar.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 72px; padding: 22px 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rail-sep, #eef0f4); background: #fff; } .ds-rail-item { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--body, #4b4f5c); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: var(--soft, #f6f7fb); color: var(--ink, #0e121b); } .ds-rail-item.is-active { background: var(--soft, #f6f7fb); color: var(--violet, #6a42e0); } .ds-rail-item.is-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -18px; top: 8px; width: 3px; height: 20px; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; background: var(--violet, #6a42e0); }

components.name: Suggestion Chip
components.description: Borderless grey chip for suggested tasks and follow-ups.
components.css: .ds-chip { max-width: 220px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--chip, #f5f6fa); color: var(--body, #4b4f5c); font: 13px/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: #eceef6; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #6a42e0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: Decision status as tinted pills with a line icon.
components.html: Status: Provisional Conditional Not feasible Primary
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 12px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ok { background: var(--status-ok-bg, #e8f7f0); color: var(--status-ok, #0f9d6b); } .ds-warn { background: var(--status-warn-bg, #fff4e0); color: var(--status-warn, #b26b00); } .ds-bad { background: var(--status-bad-bg, #fdecea); color: var(--status-bad, #c0362c); } .ds-info { background: var(--violet-soft, #efeafe); color: var(--violet, #6a42e0); }

components.name: Source Card
components.description: Soft-panel card naming a cited source, its page and use count.
components.css: .ds-source { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; width: 172px; min-height: 76px; padding: 14px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--soft, #f6f7fb); color: var(--ink, #0e121b); font: 14px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-source:hover { background: #eef0f8; } .ds-source:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #6a42e0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-source:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-source-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--body, #4b4f5c); font-size: 13px; } .ds-source-meta svg { color: var(--star, #335bfb); } .ds-uses { margin-left: auto; }

components.name: User Bubble and Citation
components.description: The lavender enquiry bubble and the inline violet citation chip.
components.html:
We want to assess whether blend potency can be measured in-line.

Fiber-based measurement is technically plausible.
components.css: .ds-thread { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; width: 460px; font: 15px/1.6 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--body, #4b4f5c); } .ds-bubble { align-self: flex-end; max-width: 80%; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 16px 16px 4px 16px; background: var(--bubble, #dcd5ff); color: var(--bubble-ink, #1b1530); line-height: 1.5; } .ds-answer { margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #0e121b); } .ds-cite { margin-left: 3px; padding: 0 5px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--violet-soft, #efeafe); color: var(--violet, #6a42e0); font: 600 11px/16px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; vertical-align: super; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-cite:hover { background: var(--bubble, #dcd5ff); } .ds-cite:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #6a42e0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Orb
components.description: The glossy purple orb, the assistant's presence on home.
components.css: .ds-orb-wrap { position: relative; width: 72px; height: 72px; margin: 40px; } .ds-orb-halo { position: absolute; inset: -60%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(193, 61, 252, 0.13) 0%, rgba(193, 61, 252, 0) 62%); } .ds-orb { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 34% 28%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 38%), radial-gradient(circle at 36% 32%, #f0b6ff 0%, #c13dfc 52%, #7b2ff7 100%); box-shadow: inset -7px -10px 16px rgba(78, 14, 150, 0.45), inset 5px 6px 12px rgba(255, 220, 255, 0.35), 0 18px 50px rgba(193, 61, 252, 0.35); animation: ds-breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-orb::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 17%; top: 11%; width: 34%; height: 22%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 72%); transform: rotate(-28deg); filter: blur(1px); } @keyframes ds-breathe { 50% { transform: scale(1.03); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-orb { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Calm Thread"**

PRISM is a light, quiet working surface: one white app card (24px corners) floating on a flat grey ground, a narrow icon rail on the left, a hairline top bar, and a single centred reading column where the enquiry, the pipeline, the sources and the cited assessment flow top to bottom as one thread. On wide screens a 300px column of white panel cards (Sources, Suggested tasks, Suggested questions) sits beside the thread as part of the same centred block. The world is pinned by the user to the Dribbble reference "Lumeo – AI Assistant Result", and the build follows it closely: Inter grotesk, ink-and-grey text, a single violet accent, a lavender user bubble, a black primary button, and a glossy purple orb as the only illustrative object.

Density is moderate and readable rather than dashboard-dense. Hierarchy comes from weight and ink colour, not from boxes: sections are separated by 28px of air, the report reads as prose with bullets, and secondary detail collapses into one-line disclosure rows. Colour is spent on meaning: violet for the active place and for links and citations, the quiet status trio (green, amber, red on tinted fills) for decision state, and the orb gradient for the assistant's presence. The old dark navy dashboard with tabs and a chat side-drawer is the confirmed rejection.

Motion is the signature. Submitting an enquiry blurs the greeting out, glides the composer to the bottom (FLIP), raises the lavender bubble, fills the panel with shimmering skeletons, and then blurs sources and results in word by word, all on one ease-out curve. Every motion has a reduced-motion fallback that collapses to a short fade or nothing.
keyCharacteristics: White card (24px radius) on a #e6e6e6 ground; 12px inset; full-bleed below 1024px.
One violet accent; one black primary button with 8px corners; tinted status pills.
Inter at 15px/1.6 body; weight and ink, not size jumps, carry hierarchy.
Flat surfaces separated by 1px cool hairlines; shadows only on floating layers.
Blur-in, word-reveal and FLIP motion on a single ease-out curve, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only interactive accent. If something is clickable and coloured, it is violet; if it is coloured and not violet, it is status or the orb.

rules.name: The Bubble Belongs to the User Rule
rules.body: Lavender marks the user's own words (the enquiry bubble, selected text). The assistant's content never sits on lavender.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: In-report sub-headings (Recommendations, Methods) stay at body size (15px) and step up to 600 ink. Size jumps are reserved for the greeting, page headings and section titles.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Tables, times and counts use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a shadow only if it floats above the thread. Cards inside the thread and panel are flat.

dos: **Do** keep every screen inside the white card on the #e6e6e6 ground, 24px corners, 12px inset on desktop.
**Do** use violet (#6a42e0) for the active place, links and citations, and for nothing decorative.
**Do** cite inline with the violet citation chip so every claim is one click from its source page.
**Do** show decision state as a tinted status pill with an icon, before the prose.
**Do** separate top-level thread sections with 28px of air and a 19px/600 title rather than boxes; collapsed detail goes in hairline-ruled one-line disclosure rows.
**Do** run motion on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` and give every animation a reduced-motion fallback.
**Do** reserve shadows for floating layers (menus, modals, drawers, composer).
donts: **Don't** bring back the dark navy dashboard, tabs, or a chat side-drawer; the thread is the product.
**Don't** put more than one ink-filled primary button in a view.
**Don't** use the greeting's magenta-to-violet gradient text anywhere but the home greeting's emphasis words.
**Don't** put assistant content on lavender; lavender is the user's voice.
**Don't** add a second accent hue; colour beyond violet is status or the orb.
